sources.used_for: 麦格克效应原始报告；视听言语整合的经典证据

sources.title: What you see is what you hear

sources.title: Humans integrate visual and haptic information in a statistically optimal fashion

sources.title: Perceptual training narrows the temporal window of multisensory binding
sources.authors: Powers AR 3rd, Hillock AR, Wallace MT
sources.used_for: TBW 可训练性；40-64%缩窄效果；机制推测（pSTS时间调谐、振荡、ACh信号）

sources.title: Multisensory integration: psychophysics, neurophysiology, and computation

sources.title: A model of the temporal dynamics of multisensory enhancement

sources.title: The construct of the multisensory temporal binding window and its dysregulation in developmental disabilities
sources.used_for: TBW 定义、测量方法、发育轨迹、ASD/阅读障碍/精神分裂症中的TBW扩宽
sources.evidence_quality: 高（综述，覆盖多个独立研究组的发现）

sources.title: Mouth and Voice: A Relationship between Visual and Auditory Preference in the Human Superior Temporal Sulcus

sources.title: Multisensory temporal binding window in autism spectrum disorders and schizophrenia spectrum disorders: A systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.authors: Zhou HY, Cai XL, Weigl M, et al.
sources.used_for: ASD和精神分裂症的TBW损伤荟萃分析；ASD：宽TBW；精神分裂症：更严重一致损伤

sources.title: Neural correlates of multisensory integration in the human brain: an ALE meta-analysis
sources.authors: Scheliga S, Kellermann T, Lampert A, Rolke R, Spehr M, Habel U

sources.evidence_quality: 高（ALE荟萃分析，跨多个感觉通道组合）

sources.title: From Multimodal Sensorimotor Integration to Semantic Networks: A Phylogenetic Perspective on Speech and Language Evolution
sources.used_for: STS 的后→前功能梯度（感觉运动整合→语义整合）；与ATL的联结
